title: Shred Armour
html:
Shred Armour is a special attack available in  Wild Shape: Sabre-Toothed Tiger form. It deals slightly less damage than the basic  Bite attack, but it reduces the target's  Armour Class by 2.

Description

Rip into a target's weaknesses, reducing their  Armour Class by 2.

Properties

Cost
 Action
Damage: 2~8 + modifiers
2d4 + Strength modifier⁠Slashing
Details
 Melee Unarmed Attack Roll
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)

At higher levels

This attack deals scaling bonus damage at higher levels:

  • +1d6⁠Slashing at level 4
  • +1d8⁠Slashing at level 8
  • +1d10⁠Slashing at level 12

Technical details

UID

Spell flags
IsHarmful, IsMelee

Condition: Shredded Armour

 Shredded Armour

Duration: 2 turns

  •  Armour Class has been reduced by 2.
  • Removed by healing.

How to learn

Used by creatures: Wild Shape: Sabre-Toothed Tiger

Notes

  • Multiple applications of  Shredded Armour do not stack.

Bugs

  • The in-game description for this action states that armour class is reduced by 1. However, the reduction is applied by the condition  Shredded Armour, which reduces it by 2.
